## a4fb12580b3f

**Reproduced teaching shortcut:** a plausible “recolor every component that touches the color-1 anchor in the 8-neighborhood” rival can survive a complete three-demonstration lesson and disagree on the query. With generator SHA-256 `092404c86bda0113b7cc90d48808a117e894911fca0c7fe351feec73ac5a8cf2`, seed `73`, difficulty `medium`, and sample indices `0,1,2,3`, the rival exactly matches the selected cardinal-touch rule on demonstrations 0–2 but incorrectly recolors the diagonal-only color-2 query component at cells `(2,0)`, `(2,1)`, and `(3,1)`. The canonical Racket authority (`c58ce5ec72e9`) was applied to all four grids and agrees with the retained selected outputs.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/a4fb12580b3f/repro_diagonal_rival.py`
- `checks/audit/a4fb12580b3f/repro_diagonal_rival.json`
- `checks/audit/a4fb12580b3f/racket_inputs.json`
- `checks/audit/a4fb12580b3f/racket_outputs.json`
- `checks/audit/a4fb12580b3f/racket-apply.log`

The isolated battery had no blocking stage failure but reported three advisories: no semantic contract, only `2/60` exact/envelope canonical-profile hits with zero support in easy and hard bands, and override-contract findings. See `checks/audit/a4fb12580b3f/battery/checks/a4fb12580b3f_before_semantic_gate.log`, `..._profile_floor.log`, and `..._override.log`.

**Suggested repair:** declare the 8-neighborhood rival and a diagonal-only non-neighbor witness, add `lesson_identifiable`, and make every production lesson—not necessarily every grid—contain a demonstration that distinguishes cardinal from diagonal contact. This target was audited only; no source was edited.
